title: Note: agents carried contradicting rules; half cut, CLAUDE.md cut awaits you

chat.text: A fresh agent read about 10,000 words of rules before working, and several of them disagreed: skills said "never commit" while CLAUDE.md says commit every step, skill fixes went to a retired agent, skills taught a server command a hook blocks, and an old copy of CLAUDE.md was loaded as a second rulebook under ai/. Those are fixed in 8 skills (about 2,600 words cut). The biggest remaining win is CLAUDE.md itself: a proposed version at 1,200 words instead of 3,758, at /framework/ai/2026-10-09/system-architect/claude-md-proposal.md — you apply it. Page: /framework/ai/2026-10-09/system-architect/
